description: "How Can I Help to Abolish Slavery?" or, Counsels to the Newly Converted by Maria Weston Chapman is a poignant anti-slavery tract written during the early to mid-19th century. The book serves as a passionate call to action for individuals seeking to contribute to the abolition of slavery, emphasizing moral duty and the transformative power of dedicated activism.
